# Question: How much technology money did schools and libraries receive?

## Answer
In 2025 the district gave a technology grant of 25,000 dollars per school [S1]. The district's technology grants totaled 25,000 dollars in 2025 [S1].

## Evidence
- The grants totaled 1.2 million dollars across 48 schools [S1].
- The technology grant was 25,000 dollars per student [S1].
- Library branches received an average of 1,800 new books [S2].
- The library system received 1,800 new books in total [S2].

## Counter-evidence and limits
- The city added 5,400 e-books to its digital catalog [S2].
- These sources do not show how schools spent the grants (judgment)

## Next actions
- Ask the district for spending by school (judgment)

## Sources
- [S1] District technology grant summary
- [S2] Library collection report
